text:
nina: OrbitWare flagged a ~$8.3k negative adjustment from last month's marketplace export. they claim late per-minute deltas got collapsed into hourly buckets and rounding flipped the ledger. tagging partners/ops.

phil: can we pull raw minute events for the affected accounts? sounds like reordering in the ingest path.

zoe: sample shows mixed increments + full snapshots. several snapshots arrived 4-6h late. our hourly merge applies in arrival order which can invert net usage.

carlos: do snapshots include a sequence id? if yes we can make snapshots canonical.

nina: OrbitWare added Snapshot-Seq in v1.9, but many customers still on older SDKs.

phil: short-term guard: if snapshot.timestamp < current_hour_state_ts - 3h, mark as "delayed-snapshot" and hold for manual review. also add alert when out-of-order ratio >0.4% over 24h.

zoe: long-term: tombstone records keyed by (partner, hour, snapshot_seq) so rollup treats snapshot as authoritative and ignores incrementals with older seq. add idempotent backfill job for affected hours.

recon-bot: created ticket PRJ-9001 "orbitware-snapshot-hold-and-backfill" assigned to @zoe (https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRJ-9001) :robot_face:

zoe: playbook: dry-run backfill -> CSV of per-customer deltas -> partner sign-off -> apply compensating adjustments via ledger-service (creates reversing entries) -> emit audit events + notify billing/legal.

carlos: owners/ETA: zoe PR for tombstone + dry-run (48h), phil add alert rule + infra estimate (24h), nina draft partner comms + legal route (24h).

nina: scheduling sync with OrbitWare tomorrow 9:30am PT to review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
